desc:
👋 Welcome to Brainrot Dice!

💵 MONEY GENERATES WHILE YOU ARE OFFLINE 🤑

How to Play:
🎲 Roll dice and reveal insane Brainrots!
🍀 Upgrade your dice to gain even more luck!
💥 Build the strongest team possible!
🏎️ Ride your brainrots and go SUPER FAST!
⚔️ Fight INSANE bosses to get SECRET rewards!
🧬 Collect rare Brainrots and mutations!

🔥 Have the BEST Brainrots and climb the leaderboards!

👍 Like the game and join the group for updates!
